name: You Owe Me
detailed_description:
Why are we unhappy?

Your colleague earns a fat paycheck but leaves all the work to you.
Your boss acts like a clueless fool, giving nonsense orders and refusing to take responsibility when things go wrong.
Your friend borrows money from you and never intends to pay it back, yet somehow acts like they're the boss.
Your annoying neighbor keeps dumping trash at your door.
You’ve gone out of your way to care for your friend, only for them to label you as “overly sentimental.”

……

Yes, life is full of frustrations, and more often than not, people are the root cause of our dissatisfaction.
But don’t worry—this game was made for one purpose: to make those who owe you pay the price!

Unleash your inner frustration through gameplay! Of course, you can also treat it as a hilarious way to blow off steam. Pick up a variety of weapons, turn your annoying friend into a cartoonish punching bag, and blast your troubles far, far away!

Gameplay:

This is a mini casual runner game where you’ll control a character armed with various weapons to “blast” the annoying people in front of you. Along the way, collect coins and power-ups to unlock stronger weapons and unleash even more satisfying chaos.

Simple controls for everyone:

  • Slide your mouse to aim and launch projectiles at your target.

  • Watch out for obstacles while running---Click the screen or press the spacebar to jump and dodge obstacles.

  • Personalize the experience by editing the name displayed above the character’s head—replace it with the name of that one person who’s been driving you crazy!

Get ready to laugh, vent, and have fun. It’s time to take charge and turn your frustrations into a game!
